treatmentStandardsRoutes.#text: Processing and recycling of aluminum waste

common:synonyms.#text: 铸铝废料；受污染铝废料

common:generalComment.#text: Aluminium scrap is the most essential input material to the recycling process. It is often categorised as 'new scrap' from production processes and 'old scrap' from post consumer use. New scrap arises during the manufacturing of aluminium semi-fabricated and final products. Old scrap refers to those products collected after use. It can be found in residential items like folding lawn chairs and commercial items like airplanes.
废铝是回收过程中最基本的输入材料。它通常被分为生产过程中产生的 "新废料 "和消费后使用的 "旧废料"。新废料产生于铝半成品和最终产品的生产过程中。旧废料是指使用后收集的产品。它可以在折叠草坪椅等家用物品和飞机等商用物品中找到。
